name: d146ca16d052
claim: Declaring a TLS fix complete after a chain check plus an unauthenticated health probe is partial evidence; the full gate set is chain verification, hostname-vs-SAN against the address the peer dials, an authenticated bearer round-trip to a real endpoint, and real delivery machinery with byte-exact receipts.

decisions.notes: Chain+health declared fixed; layers 2 and 3 were still failing (SAN missing, portal token mismatch) and the peer correctly rejected the fixed claim until all four gates passed.

rationale: Each TLS/auth layer is independent; report per-gate PASS/FAIL with exact errors and never say fixed before the machinery gate passes on both directions.
